acceptance_predicates.description: The strict-state failure is reproduced on the exact current base and classified as pre-existing.
Restored modules match the exact coordinator.vendor.json Coordinator source or have an independently reviewed compatibility diff with hashes.
Barrier, repository identity, rollback/commit, WAL/SHM recovery, and fail-closed negative checks remain present and pass.
Formatting, mypy, authority tests, 95% coverage, doctor, render-status, AWQ, DCO, and signature checks pass at the exact repair head.
Only coordination quality is changed; product behavior and development-only nonblocking semantics remain unchanged.

definition_of_done: The strict state workflow is green on the exact repair head.
Independent review confirms provenance, safety preservation, no suppression, no exclusion, and no gate weakening.

inputs.description: Hosted strict-state failure and exact-base reproduction receipt.

outputs.description: Exact-head provenance, safety, baseline/repair, and hosted-check evidence.

gates.description: The complete Git-backed state verification workflow passes without new exclusions, suppressed errors, or removed coordinator safety checks.
